# TPC-DS-OBT Q42

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT sold_date_d_year, item_i_category_id, item_i_category, SUM(ext_sales_price) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk AND obt.item_sk = item_i_item_sk AND item_i_manager_id = 1 AND sold_date_d_moy = 11 AND sold_date_d_year = 1998) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY sold_date_d_year, item_i_category_id, item_i_category ORDER BY SUM(ext_sales_price) DESC, sold_date_d_year, item_i_category_id, item_i_category LIMIT 100
```
